evidence: FIRST_PARTY 2026Q1 consolidated balance sheet: cash and cash equivalents NT$63.311bn; current assets NT$234.088bn versus current liabilities NT$170.375bn (current-asset coverage ~1.37x). Source: https://www.gigabyte.com/FileUpload/Global/SiteMap/134/images/FinancialReport-2026Q1-en.pdf

FIRST_PARTY 2026Q1 debt/liquidity: unsecured short-term bank loans NT$69.228bn against committed/available credit lines disclosed at NT$128.709bn; current portion of convertible-bond liabilities NT$9.345bn. Cash plus disclosed credit-line capacity is sufficient to cover these near-term funding claims in the model stress screen without assuming rescue equity. Source: https://www.gigabyte.com/FileUpload/Global/SiteMap/134/images/FinancialReport-2026Q1-en.pdf

FIRST_PARTY refinancing profile: fourth overseas unsecured convertible bond matures 2029-07-23; third overseas unsecured convertible bond matures 2028-07-27. The 2024 bond has a 0% coupon and 0.875% maturity yield; maturities are not concentrated inside the next 12 months, though put/conversion features require monitoring. Source: https://www.gigabyte.com/FileUpload/Global/SiteMap/134/images/FinancialReport-2026Q1-en.pdf

FIRST_PARTY cash-flow stress: 2026Q1 OCF was -NT$20.653bn, driven primarily by a NT$69.440bn inventory increase, partly funded by a NT$35.085bn accounts-payable increase and higher short-term borrowing. This is a material working-capital/cash-conversion risk, but current liquidity does not indicate existential or rescue-financing risk. Source: https://www.gigabyte.com/FileUpload/Global/SiteMap/134/images/FinancialReport-2026Q1-en.pdf

SURVIVAL MODEL JUDGMENT: PASS means the company appears able to survive a 24-36m operating/working-capital stress without rescue financing based on disclosed liquidity; it does not mean cash-flow quality passes. Revoke PASS if cash plus undrawn facilities no longer cover short-term borrowings/current bond puts, current-asset coverage falls below 1.0x, or persistent negative OCF is financed mainly by incremental debt without inventory/cash conversion.
